Task: Write a Python function iso_duration_seconds(s) that converts an ISO 8601 duration string to a number of seconds (a float). It must handle: "PT0S" -> 0, "PT1H30M" -> 5400, "P1DT2H" -> 93600, "P1W" -> 604800, "PT0.5S" -> 0.5, "P2DT3H4M5.25S" -> 183845.25, and it must raise ValueError for "", "P", "PT", "1H" and "P1H". Use 1 day = 86400 seconds and 1 week = 7 days; years and months are not supported and must raise ValueError. Write the function and tests for every case above, run the tests, and fix the code until every test passes. Then report the final test output.
